data.fund_name: ADITYA BIRLA SUN LIFE REGULAR SAVINGS FUND
data.fund_type: An open ended hybrid scheme investing predominantly in debt instruments
data.investment_objective: The primary objective of the scheme is to generate regular income so as to make monthly payments or distribution to unit holders, with the secondary objective being growth of capital. There can be no assurance that the Scheme objectives will be realised.
data.asset_allocation:
Under normal circumstances, the asset allocation of the Scheme will be as follows:
Instruments - Risk Profile -  Range
Debt and Money Market securities (including securitized debt upto maximum of 50%) - Low to Medium - 75%-90%
Equities and equity related instruments - Medium to High - 10%-25%
Units issued by InvITs - Medium to High - 0%-10%
data.exit_load: For redemption /switch-out of units on or before 90 days from the date of allotment: 1.00% of applicable NAV. For redemption / switch-out of units after 90 days from the date of allotment: Nil.
